answer: Require each agent to lock a stake in a shared escrow that a beacon oracle releases only after the agent completes verifiable work over time, like a slow karst drip wearing stone. The stake sits on a basalt-hard bonding curve: creating one identity is cheap, but each extra identity costs exponentially more, so a sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes that get slashed when any copy misbehaves, making mass fakery unprofitable.
